Subject: Your land dispute matter - R.C.S. No. 1465/2022

Dear Ms. Srivastava,

Thank you for meeting us on 12 January 2023 about your dispute with Kavya Pawar. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. The matter is listed before the Kolhapur District Court.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
